settings.title: Settings
settings.api.test_empty: Please enter an API Key first
settings.prompt.warning: ⚠️ Do not ask the prompt to modify placeholders such as [IMG0] or [EQ1] — they stand for equations/images and are preserved automatically.
settings.prompt.proof: Proofreading prompt. {text} is the source text placeholder — do not modify it
settings.prompt.proof_placeholder: You are a Chinese academic proofreading expert. Fix typos, grammar, punctuation and terminology. Remove the space between numbers and ℃, %, ° (e.g. 2℃, 5%, 9°); keep a half-width space before other units (e.g. 10 m).
settings.prompt.translate: Translation prompt. {text} is the source placeholder, {target_lang} is the target language placeholder — do not modify them
settings.prompt.rewrite: Rewrite prompt. {text} is the source placeholder, {style} is the style placeholder — do not modify them
settings.appearance.skin_hint: Skins live in assets/skins/<id>/ — drop in a new folder to add a look. The pet’s right-click menu switches too.
settings.appearance.custom_hint: Edit {path} to override built-in styles; changes apply on save (no restart needed).
settings.appearance.qss_missing: {path} has not been generated yet; it will be created after restarting the app.
monitor.title: API Call Monitor
prompt.proof.default:
You are a proofreading expert for academic and technical writing. Fix spelling, grammar, punctuation and terminology. In unit spacing: no space between a number and ℃, % or ° (e.g. 2℃, 5%, 9°); keep a half-width space before other units (e.g. 10 m).
Text: {text}
prompt.proof.system: Output the full proofread text only. No explanation, no questions.
prompt.proof.placeholder_system: Output the full proofread text only. No explanation, no questions. If the input contains markers such as [IMG0] or [EQ1], they are inline object placeholders and must be preserved exactly.
prompt.translate.default:
Translate the following text into {target_lang}. Output the translation only:
{text}
prompt.translate.system: You are a translation bot. Return the translation only, with no explanation.
prompt.rewrite.default:
Rewrite the following text in a {style} style. Output the rewritten text only:
{text}
prompt.rewrite.system: You are a rewriting bot. Do not chat, ask questions, or add extra text. Give the rewritten result directly.
prompt.error: Something went wrong. Please check your API settings and network connection!
